options.name: Expert
options.prompt: Expert: Provides authoritative insights and analysis. For example a Scientists, historians, industry leaders.

options.name: Eyewitness
options.examples: Participants in historical events, local residents
options.prompt: Eyewitness: Offers first-hand accounts of events. For example a participant in a historical event, a local resident.

options.name: Affected Individual
options.description: Shares personal experiences related to the topic
options.examples: Patients in medical documentaries, environmental impact victims
options.prompt: Affected Individual: Shares personal experiences related to the topic. For example a patient in a medical documentary, an environmental impact victim.

options.name: Instructor
options.description: Guides learners through concepts and skills
options.prompt: Instructor: Guides learners through concepts and skills. For example a teacher, a trainer, a coach.

options.name: Student/Learner
options.description: Demonstrates the learning process, asks questions
options.prompt: Student/Learner: Demonstrates the learning process, asks questions. For example an on-screen learner, a relatable character.

options.name: Practitioner
options.examples: Professionals in their field, experienced craftspeople
options.prompt: Practitioner: Shows real-world application of knowledge. For example a professional in their field, an experienced craftsperson.

options.name: CEO/Executive
options.prompt: CEO/Executive: Provides vision and leadership perspective. For example a company founder, top management.

options.name: Employee
options.description: Offers insights into company culture and operations
options.prompt: Employee: Offers insights into company culture and operations. For example a team member, a department head.

options.name: Client/Partner
options.description: Shares experiences of working with the company
options.prompt: Client/Partner: Shares experiences of working with the company. For example a business partner, a long-term client.

options.name: Content Creator
options.prompt: Content Creator: Shares personal experiences and opinions. For example a vlogger, an influencer.

options.name: Guest
options.prompt: Guest: Provides additional perspectives or expertise. For example a friend, a collaborator, an interviewee.

options.name: Audience Stand-in
options.examples: Character asking questions viewers might have
options.prompt: Audience Stand-in: Represents the viewer's perspective. For example a character asking questions viewers might have.
